## Conagra Brands — Last Four Reported Fiscal Quarters (as of March 31, 2026)

Conagra had reported **fiscal 2026 Q1 and Q2** along with **fiscal 2025 Q3 and Q4**. Note that **Q3 FY26 (period ended Feb 22, 2026) was not released until April 1, 2026**, so it is excluded.

| Fiscal Quarter | Fiscal Year | Period-End Date | Reported Date | Net Sales ($M) | GAAP Diluted EPS ($, as reported) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q2 | FY2026 | Nov 23, 2025 | Dec 19, 2025 | 2,979.1 | (1.39) *(net loss)* |
| Q1 | FY2026 | Aug 24, 2025 | Oct 1, 2025 | 2,632.6 | 0.34 |
| Q4 | FY2025 | May 25, 2025 | Jul 10, 2025 | 2,781.8 | 0.53 |
| Q3 | FY2025 | Feb 23, 2025 | Apr 3, 2025 | 2,841.0 | 0.30 |

### Notes on the figures

- **Q2 FY26:** GAAP diluted loss per share of **$(1.39)**, driven primarily by non-cash goodwill and brand impairment charges (~$1.88/share). Adjusted EPS was $0.45. Reported net sales decreased 6.8% to $2,979.1M.
- **Q1 FY26:** GAAP diluted EPS of **$0.34** (included a ~$42.4M pre-tax gain on divestitures); adjusted EPS was $0.39. Net sales of $2,632.6M.
- **Q4 FY25:** GAAP diluted EPS of **$0.53**; adjusted EPS was $0.56. Net sales of $2,781.8M (reported net sales decreased 4.3%).
- **Q3 FY25:** GAAP diluted EPS of **$0.30** (down 53.1%); adjusted EPS was $0.51. Net sales of $2,841.0M (reported net sales decreased 6.3%).

**Sources:**
- Q2 FY26 earnings release (Dec 19, 2025): https://www.conagrabrands.com/news-room/news-conagra-brands-reports-second-quarter-results-prn-122942 ; SEC 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23217/000110465925123200/tmb-20251123x10q.htm
- Q1 FY26 earnings release (Oct 1, 2025): https://www.conagrabrands.com/news-room/news-conagra-brands-reports-first-quarter-results-prn-122968
- Q4 FY25 earnings release (Jul 10, 2025): https://www.conagrabrands.com/news-room/news-conagra-brands-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-results-prn-122958
- Q3 FY25 earnings release (Apr 3, 2025): https://www.conagrabrands.com/news-room/news-conagra-brands-reports-third-quarter-results-prn-122917 ; SEC 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23217/000155837025004399/tmb-20250223x10q.htm
